resources.string: Peak brightness on demand, Quick Settings tile, sunlight threshold
Unlock the panel\'s peak brightness at any time and set brightness to maximum. Turning it off restores your previous brightness.
Use your own light threshold for automatic peak brightness (requires adaptive brightness)
Stock is 10000 lux; direct sunlight is usually above 20000
Stock allows peak brightness for only 5 minutes in every 30. Removing the limit increases heat and battery use.

Peak brightness is still disabled while HDR content is on screen, in Battery Saver, and when the display gets hot. Automatic mode only works with adaptive brightness on, because the ambient light reading comes from it.
